requirements.description: Energy class C or better, as explicitly requested by the user for the office building to be converted into a student residence.
User wants the property located near public transport. Value set to the 75th percentile (70.93, rounded to 71) of the mobility distribution.
A university student residence requires proximity to universities and schools. Value set to the 75th percentile (75.14, rounded to 75) of the education distribution.

The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area, which maps directly to the surface_area column. The 60-person capacity, energy class, public transport proximity, and CDP/PNRR funding are not gross-area requirements or reference columns, so they are not converted into filters.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE surface_area >= 850 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND education >= 75 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Applies the extracted requirements only: surface_area >= 850; a 3.0 km haversine radius around 45.0677551, 7.6824892; energy_class in A1-A4, B, C; mobility >= 71; education >= 75. Results are ordered by distance from the coordinate, ascending. No capacity or property-type filter was included because none was extracted.
